item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-10-25 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 8 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Enterprise Software is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (6). Plex has the most new KEV entries this week (4). CVE-2026-31431 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 942 positions.
